content.text: FacebookLog InLog InForgot Account?FABULOUS FILMS & STARS · JoinArianna Valeria · March 7 at 10:10 PM · Shared with Public groupIt amazes me that Ed Harris has never been awarded an Oscar. He'll probably end up with some BS Lifetime Achievement Oscar. Guess that's why the Academy Awards have lost their cachet for me. Of course, that downturn started in 2001 when Julia Roberts won for Erin Brockovich over Ellen Burstyn in Requiem for a Dream. Granted, a depressingly dark movie, but damned if she didn't act her butt off.I digress. One of my favorite male actors, regardless of the medium, period.All reactions:20860 commentsLikeCommentShareMost relevant Cathy BandoianThe academy awards are political.
